papers.title: Learning from Repaired Reasoning: Root-Cause-Guided On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Proposes an on-policy distillation method for LLM reasoning that locates the root-cause error in a student's failed reasoning trace and learns from a repaired version of it. This gives targeted token-level supervision on the student's own distribution rather than generic teacher imitation.

papers.title: All Work And No Play Makes Jack a Dull Boy: Understanding and Preventing Catastrophic Strategy Collapse in RLVR
papers.summary: Gives a theoretical account of why GRPO-style RLVR post-training collapses late in training: the objectives concentrate probability on a single reasoning strategy while accuracy needs a minimum strategy capacity. Introduces the Mirrored Entanglement Index as an online warning signal and Mesh Learning to preserve strategy diversity, with gains of up to 13.4 pp on reasoning benchmarks.
